completed_chapter_legacy_name_policy: V01-C01 remains byte-identical; final editorial normalization is deferred.

epistemic_status_dimensions.curatorial_canon: Whether a formulation is historical, candidate, operative, current working candidate, or final canon.
epistemic_status_dimensions.formal_mathematical_proof: Existence, uniqueness, invariance, stability, and theorem-level proof obligations for stated constructions.
epistemic_status_dimensions.metadata_recovery: Completeness with which the Library exposes existing records and ancestry; not a verdict on physical truth.
epistemic_status_dimensions.operator_typing: Explicit domains, codomains, composition rules, kernels, images, dimensions, and admissibility conditions.
epistemic_status_dimensions.physical_observational_validation: Compatibility of model outputs with measured or simulated observables; independent of whether every upstream operator has a completed proof.
epistemic_status_dimensions.provenance: Lineage of a statement or equation through foundational source, QMO derivation, API-native derivation, Clover synthesis, Genesis curation, or external established mathematics.
epistemic_status_dimensions.publication: Whether sufficient definitions, derivations, qualifications, and disclosure have been assembled for scientific release.

global_status_policy: Local formal, typing, provenance, recovery, canon, validation, and publication statuses must not be collapsed into one global verdict.
historical_machine_identifier_policy: Preserve exact spelling when quoting a filename, identifier, URI, archive, module, or source string.
identity_policy: Identity, equivalence, dependency, projection, realization, construction, representation, and role alias are distinct relations.
natural_regime_policy: T0-T7 and R0-R7 are natural domains/regimes, never software pipelines.
